claims.statement: The project registers exactly 14 modules in settings.gradle.kts (:app, :core:model, :core:common, :core:ui, :domain, :data, :player, six :feature:* modules, :benchmark), which is the same list verifyProductArchitecture requires.

Feature modules may depend only on :core:model, :core:common, :core:ui and :domain; no feature build file declares project(":data"), project(":player") or another project(":feature:..."), and verifyProductArchitecture fails any build file that adds them, so cross-feature navigation must be routed through :app.

:player and :data are symmetric middle layers that each depend only on :core:model, :core:common and :domain (plus platform libraries such as Media3, Room, DataStore and Hilt); neither depends on the other or on any feature module.

:domain contains no Android or Compose dependencies at all (no file under domain/src/main/java imports android.* or androidx.*); it api-exposes :core:model and implementation-depends on :core:common, making it a pure interface/policy layer.

:core:model is the dependency-free bottom layer holding pure data types (Song, Playlist, PlayQueue, AlbumEntry, ArtistEntry, LyricLine, SongInfo, SongEmotion, TimeSlotConfig, ThemeMode/ThemeVariant); its only external dependency is compose-runtime for @Stable/@Immutable annotations, and Song itself stores an android.net.Uri.

:app is the only module that depends on every other module (:core:*, :domain, :data, :player and all six features); AppNavHost.kt is the single composition point that wires feature Route composables together, so no feature renders another feature's UI.

Hilt product assembly is anchored at four verified entry points: MelodyApplication (@HiltAndroidApp), MainActivity (@AndroidEntryPoint), AppMediaSessionService in :player (@AndroidEntryPoint), and PlayerViewModel in :feature:player (@HiltViewModel).

Seven SingletonComponent Hilt modules exist and are enforced: app/di CoroutineModule, LoggerModule, PlayerModule; data/di DatabaseModule, DataStoreModule, RepositoryModule; plus player's AppCoroutineScopeModule, which provides the @ApplicationScope process-level CoroutineScope so playback-snapshot persistence survives service destruction.

Repository implementations follow a narrow-adapter pattern: MusicRepository is an internal storage coordinator that implements none of the domain repository interfaces; RepositoryModule binds each :domain interface to a dedicated adapter class (SongRepositoryAdapter, PlaylistRepositoryAdapter, MusicImportRepositoryAdapter, AlbumArtRepositoryAdapter) that delegates to it, with MediaMetadataRepository serving both LyricsRepository and SongMetadataRepository.

verifyProductArchitecture enforces the adapter pattern in both directions: imports of cn.com.dcsgo.mihx.data.repository.* or cn.com.dcsgo.mihx.data.local.* are banned in feature/, domain/ and player/ sources, MusicRepository must not declare SongRepository/PlaylistRepository/MusicImportRepository/AlbumArtRepository as supertypes, and the four *RepositoryAdapter.kt files must exist and implement their named domain interface.

app/di/PlayerModule is the binding point for all playback Ports declared in :domain's cn.com.dcsgo.mihx.domain.playback package: ControllerQueuePlannerPort, PlaybackControllerPortFactory, PlaybackStateStorageFactory, PlaybackStateRepository, BluetoothPlaybackMonitorFactory, PlaybackDurationMonitorFactory and PlayerQueueServicesFactory.

:feature:player consumes the ports through PlayerRuntimeFactory, whose constructor injects ControllerQueuePlannerPort, PlaybackControllerPortFactory, PlaybackStateStorageFactory, BluetoothPlaybackMonitorFactory, PlaybackDurationMonitorFactory and PlayerQueueServicesFactory and passes them into PlayerRuntime; e.g. PlayerControllerQueueFacade builds windowed sync plans solely via the ControllerQueuePlannerPort abstraction.

The :player module supplies WindowedControllerQueuePlanner (in player/window/) as the ControllerQueuePlannerPort implementation; it delegates to ControllerWindowSynchronizer.planControllerQueue, keeping the window algorithm dependent only on :core:model and :domain playback policy.

PlaybackStateStore in :player is a single class that implements both the :domain PlaybackStateStorage port and PlaybackStateRepository interface; PlayerModule provides it as the singleton storage and hands it out through both factories, backed by the playback_state DataStore with legacy SharedPreferences fallback.

PlaybackControllerPortFactory creates PlaybackController bound to AppMediaSessionService::class.java, so the Media3 playback control path is UI -> PlaybackControllerPort -> PlaybackController (MediaController client, FIFO pending-action cap 64) -> AppMediaSessionService (MediaSessionService owning ExoPlayer), all cross-module edges via :domain abstractions.

verifyProductArchitecture is a custom root Gradle task (group verification) whose ~530-line doLast block walks all kt/kts/java/xml/toml files (excluding build/.gradle/.git/.idea dirs) and throws GradleException on the first violated rule; the root check task depends on spotlessCheck, verifyProductArchitecture and every subproject's check, making it the standard pre-commit gate.

The release-build rule extracts the :app release block with a first-closing-brace regex, so nested braces inside that block break the check; app/build.gradle.kts documents this and keeps signingConfig = releaseSigningConfig (resolved outside the block) as its only inner assignment.

Room schema history is immutability-checked: 1.json must not contain quick_skip_short_play_counts, 2.json must contain it but not lrcUri, 3.json must contain lrcUri, and DatabaseModule must keep Migration(1,2), Migration(2,3) and addMigrations(MIGRATION_1_2, MIGRATION_2_3) registered.

The exported schema history has grown to 10.json: MelodyDatabase declares version = 10 with 13 entities and DatabaseModule registers all migrations MIGRATION_1_2 through MIGRATION_9_10; the standing rule is to add new snapshots/migrations, never edit existing schema JSON files.

Both app/src/main/res/xml/backup_rules.xml and data_extraction_rules.xml must exclude the privacy-sensitive stores (legacy prefs music_player_prefs/play_stats_prefs/quick_skip_songs_prefs, melody.db plus -journal/-shm/-wal, datastore/player_settings.preferences_pb, datastore/playback_state.preferences_pb, cache/album_art/); missing entries fail the build.

The gate fixes release build shape and manifest placement: :app release must set isMinifyEnabled = true and isShrinkResources = true, a benchmark build type must inherit release settings, the :app manifest must not declare AppMediaSessionService (it lives in the :player manifest) nor request READ_MEDIA_AUDIO/READ_EXTERNAL_STORAGE (import is SAF document-tree based).

Code-quality gates include: every LazyColumn item/items/itemsIndexed call in app, core and feature sources must pass a stable key, and direct android.util.Log calls are banned everywhere except AppLogger.kt in favor of AppLog/AppLogger (which redact URIs/paths in release).

Privacy-sensitive startup rules are enforced: Bluetooth playback monitoring must be user-triggered from Settings (PlayerStartupFacade must not mention Bluetooth; SettingsScreen must expose the 蓝牙播放监听/申请蓝牙权限 controls; the setting must flow through PlayerSettingsRepository/DataStore into PlayerUiState), and startup-path files (MainActivity, AppRoot, PlayerRuntime, PlayerStartupFacade) must not request notification or Bluetooth permissions.

Observability anchors are enforced: MusicRepository must keep the music_import_scan and music_import_folder PerformanceTrace operations and PlaybackController the controller_play_queue/controller_prepare_queue/controller_sync_queue/play_next_command operations; PlaybackWindowPerformanceShapeTest must keep covering 100/500/1_000/71-song window sizing; :benchmark must remain a Macrobenchmark module targeting :app with a StartupBenchmark using MacrobenchmarkRule, StartupTimingMetric and StartupMode.COLD.

Every required module must keep a local .gitignore containing /build/, /.cxx/, /.externalNativeBuild/ and /captures/; the gate fails naming the first module whose ignore file is missing or incomplete.

The port indirection keeps :feature:player logic unit-testable off-device: PlayerControllerQueueFacadeTest substitutes a hand-written fake ControllerQueuePlannerPort instead of any Media3 or :player implementation.
